name: hud_ui_background_cursor_set_image_borrowed_refresh
description: HudUiBackgroundCursorWidget::SetImageBorrowedAndRefresh guards on capture/image availability, replaces any previous captured image, creates a 16-bit captured image matching the current source image, then captures the current background under the widget coordinates.
known_limits: The smoke covers the enabled capture path with no previous captured image. Previous-image destruction and create-failure returns are source-reviewed against Binary Ninja and accepted zVid_Image helpers.
Reconstructed remains limited because this cursor-widget cluster carries naming/codegen debt; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent HudUiBackground cursor-widget pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x4bfae0 validates captureEnabled/base.image guards, previous captured-image destruction, zVid_Image create/size/pixel allocation/setup, format flag 0x20, GetY/GetX ftable calls, and RebuildCapturedImage dispatch.
The native smoke verifies captured image allocation, size/format setup, background pixel capture, and installed blit source/clip rect through the current widget coordinates.
